mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months signals monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring absolute level thresholds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it indicates labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for this condition is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production (INDPRO) combined with rising consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) indicates supply-constrained inflation that erodes corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 99.0 and CPIAUCSL > 233.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1% monthly), reduced liquidity and higher discount rates suppress equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during FEDFUNDS rising periods, or the Rank IC for tightening cycles is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without level thresholds.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900 thousand units, it reflects strong consumer demand for housing that accelerates economic growth and equity market performance, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 900, or the Rank IC for this condition is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) combined with falling industrial production (INDPRO) indicates demand surge outpacing supply capacity, creating inflationary pressures that reduce equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST rises >0.5% MoM and INDPRO falls >0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion phases (GDPC1 growth rate exceeding 3.0% annually), economic overheating and impending monetary tightening lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annually, or the Rank IC for late-cycle periods is below 0.02.
